Copy for the Instagram story cards. Edit the words here, then run scripts/render-story-cards.py. Only 'name' and 'big' are required. Use
in 'big' for a deliberate line break. Cards render in this order and are numbered accordingly.

cards.name: what
cards.label: 九州八十八湯
cards.en: From October, I am travelling around the best onsens of Kyushu, on foot.
cards.ja: 十月から、九州の名湯を歩いて巡ります。

cards.name: challenge
cards.label: THE CHALLENGE
cards.big: Catch them all, using my two feet
cards.en: The goal is to collect 88 stamps from a pool of 160 onsens. Where it gets interesting is a favorite personal twist of mine of travelling like in the olden days. No car, no public transport. Just my own two feet.
cards.ja: 対象は約160湯、そのうち88湯の湯印を集めます。面白いのはここから。昔ながらの旅のやり方で、車も公共交通も使わず、自分の足だけで回ります。

cards.name: walk
cards.label: THE WALK
cards.en: Which onsens I choose does not matter, but they have to come from all 7 prefectures of Kyushu. As such, this will be a considerable walk, taking a whole month, or perhaps more.
cards.ja: どの湯を選ぶかは自由。ただし九州七県すべてから集める必要があります。だからこそ、一ヶ月あるいはそれ以上の長い道のりになります。

cards.name: rule
cards.label: THE RULE
cards.en: No trains between onsens, no buses, no car. If an onsen closes in front of my eyes, I either wait for it to open, or walk to the next one. No exceptions.
cards.ja: 湯から湯へ、電車もバスも車も使いません。目の前で暖簾が下りたら、開くまで待つか、次の湯まで歩くか。例外はなし。

cards.name: tool
cards.label: THE TOOL
cards.en: I put together a public iOS app for tracking all visits, posting photos, and more. Every step will be counted, every onsen recorded.
cards.ja: 訪れた湯を記録するiOSアプリを自分で作りました。写真も残せます。一歩も、一湯も、取りこぼさないように。

cards.name: follow
cards.label: FOLLOW
cards.big: A live map of the walk.
cards.en: The application will propagate data live onto the site below. You can track my steps (and baths) live as I add them.
cards.ja: アプリに記録すると、下のサイトにそのまま反映されます。歩いた道も、入った湯も、その場で見られます。
